enthusiastic medical student welcoming to my medical cases blog journey\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe first case that i have seen in the course of medicine is in my 3rd semester where the patient was lying on the bed and he looked so weak and when I approached the patient\u0026nbsp; he complained of fever since 2 days . He is also having body aches, headache and loss of appetite\u0026nbsp; I was so fasinatate to learn the pathophysiology of fever and causes and how it makes us physically and mentally weak.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAnd the case was\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/blog\/post\/edit\/5638447817479559920\/2371950410185238935\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.blogger.com\/blog\/post\/edit\/5638447817479559920\/2371950410185238935\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThrough this case I learned the types of fever pattern and which can lead to diagnose a case through clinical approach\u0026nbsp; and how to make fever charts and diagnosis of fever based on type of raise wbc count .raised lymphocytes indicate viral fever and raised granulocytes indicate bacterial cause of fever.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Fever caused by virus would be sudden and high grade and would not last more than 1 week where as fever caused by bacteria would last more than a week\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIdeal sites to measure temperature like to measure core body temperature rectum and to measure surface body temperature arm pit is ideal and correction to be done to\u0026nbsp; get accurate temperature\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAnother interesting, most common case that seen is patient with yellow discoloration of eyes with eye colour urine since 1week\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/dvntejaswinirollno40.blogspot.com\/2022\/08\/35-yrs-old-m-with-yellow-discoloration.html\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/dvntejaswinirollno40.blogspot.com\/2022\/08\/35-yrs-old-m-with-yellow-discoloration.html\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThrough these case i learned about\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1.IMPORTANCE OF LFT?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2.jaudice pathogenesis and how alcohol induces hepatitis?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAlchol is converted into acetaldehyde which can bind to liver cell protein forming neoantigen and leading to inflammation\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAnd also metabolism of Alchol generate hydrogen which cinvert NAD TO NADH which increase redox potential inhibits fatty acid oxidation and gluconeogenesis, promoting fat accumulation in the liver\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3.learned about approach to jaudice case, how to differentiate different type of jaudice and diffential diagnosis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EClinically\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;hemolytic jaudice - lemon yellow colour jaundice, mild in nature, stool and urine color normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHepatocellular - orange yellow color jaundice, moderate, stool color normal, urine color dark\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EObstructive jaundice -\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGreenish yellow jaundice, deep in depth of jaundice where stool color light, urine color dark\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cfont color=\"#000000\" face=\"sans-serif\" size=\"3\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"caret-color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003EA 60 year old gentleman came to the casualty with the cheif complaints of edema of both upper and lower limbs since 10 days,complaints of facial swelling decreased urine output since yesterday, vomiting of 6 episodes on \u0026nbsp;Saturday , loose stools of 4 episodes \u0026nbsp;on Sunday\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"caret-color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"caret-color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;Hopi:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"caret-color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 10 days back then he developed Bilateral pedal edema since 10 days which was insidious in onset and gradually progressive in nature \u0026nbsp;for which he admitted in government hospital. Condition worsened and swelling of face bilateral upper limb started 4 days back .\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003EComplaints of decreased urine output on day before presentation\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003EAssociated with 6 episodes of vomiting food particles as content non bilious non projectile non blood tinged\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003E4 episodes of loose stools watery non blood stained\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003ENo history of fever, palpitations, sob, pain abdomen, sweating, burning micturition.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003ESEQUENCE OF EVENTS;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003E18 Yrs back he was diagnosed with type2 DM\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;￬\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003EAround 6 years back, one fine day when he went to pass urine, patient suddenly had LOC for around 10 mins with involuantry movements of ?Rt Upper limb and lower limb, uprolling of eyes + , tongue bite + frothing from mouth + and he was taken to local hospital where they were said to have to significant findings in CT and he hasn't been started on any medications and sent to home with in 2-3 days. \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; ￬\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003E4 months back he complained of pedal edema for which they went to nalgonda hsptl and stayed approximately 1 week and resolved edema ,while planning for discharge he suddenly developed vomitings for 3days (non bilious, non projectile vomitings) later on his sensorium deteriorated and aphasia also developed and brought to our hsptl and found out to be having hyponatremia and hypokalemia and corrected with 3%NS and later with in 1-2 days patient became normal and thought of SIADH secondary to ?frontal lobe contusion and he was discharged with normal electrolyts.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;
